notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Money operations accept idempotency_key and check audit first: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an existing entry with that key before validating state, returning the original record without reapplying; include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Use to_money and ZERO from money module: In ledgerly/invoice.py, coerce line prices with to_money() and seed sums with ZERO from ledgerly.money, mirroring line_total and invoice_total.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with snake_case codes like `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity`, `negative_amount`; include `repr()` of the offending value as the detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Guard mutations on invoice.status == draft: Mutating invoice operations must first check `invoice.status != "draft"` and raise `BillingError("invalid_state", ...)`, matching the pattern in `issue_invoice`.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
